body:
## What to build

Typed Grouping-plan inspection and nesting over an immutable derived dtplyr input must use faithful column metadata or refuse safely before returning an incorrect plan. A caller-local bracket S3 method must not make a real Grouping dimension or fixed key disappear during the isolated zero-row preparation.

Confirmed on main `952a0d9b18fd3ff4631f153432f6024ad62fcac2` with R 4.6.1, dplyr 1.2.1, dtplyr 1.3.3 and data.table 1.18.6.1. Start with character key g containing a and b and integer payload v containing 1 and 2. Make an immutable lazy table and increment v. In the caller's environment, bind a data.table bracket method that delegates to the ordinary method for populated input but makes g integer in its zero-row result. Leave the bracket generic and global S3 registry unchanged.

Native collection retains character g and both rows. A character predicate in either the Grouping dimension or fixed-key position nevertheless produces an empty selection during inspection. Both Nest verbs then return one keyless cell instead of the two keyed cells. Removing the local method restores all six outcomes. Source serialization remains unchanged.

The 54-case matrix had six failures (the derived arithmetic input, the two typed-selection positions and three consumers) and 48 matching controls, including name-only selections, a direct root and filtering. An independent Git-archive replay reproduced the failed desired-behavior assertion. ADR 0020's dtplyr metadata amendment requires faithful metadata or safe refusal.

This is adjacent to closed #1326, whose witness replaced the bracket generic. The generic-identity repair does not detect this local S3 method. Closed #1341 and PR #1352 protected the generated full-join merge call, including its method lookup; they did not protect bracket method resolution.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Typed inspection selects g correctly, or gives the documented metadata-safety Package condition, when a caller-local bracket method can change zero-row metadata.
- [ ] Both Nest verbs preserve the two source partitions under both typed Grouping-dimension and fixed-key selection, or refuse before producing a misleading result.
- [ ] Preserve the unmasked, name-only, direct-root and filter controls, source immutability, and the existing prohibition on implicit full-source metadata evaluation.
- [ ] Add focused regression coverage distinguishing a caller-local S3 method from a replaced generic and from changes to the global S3 registry.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

comments.body: The dated reproductions, controls, independent replay and duplicate dispositions are recorded in [investigation PR #1367](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1367). That PR contains evidence only; the implementation repair remains in this ticket.
Implemented in #1371 together with #1366. The PR carries the pinned full Review-ready and independent Standards/Spec review records.

title: [P2] Keep dtplyr typed metadata faithful under caller bracket S3 methods
